item.title: My Family in Fergana
item.summary: Madina introduces her family and their house with a garden in Fergana.
item.content_markdown:
Hello! My name is Madina, and I am fifteen years old. I live in Fergana with my family. There are six people in my family: my mother, my father, my grandmother, my two brothers and me.

My father is a driver, and my mother is a teacher at a school near our house. My grandmother doesn't work. She cooks very good plov! My big brother, Sardor, is a student in Tashkent. He comes home every month. My little brother, Ali, is seven.

Our house is not big, but it has a garden. There are apple trees and a grape vine in the garden. In summer, we sit outside and drink tea in the evening. I love my family and our home.
